name: Selkies
description: Low-latency HTML5 remote desktop streaming for Linux (WebSocket and WebRTC)

xserver.description: type of xserver to use, if xvfb, Xserver will be created automatically

desktop.description: The desktop environment to install (LXQt) or none

wayland.description: Use the headless Wayland backend instead of X11 (default: false).

web_port.description: The port number to listen on to host the web interface and signal server.
